environment.description: Same EKS 1.28 cluster but namespace has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted applied via Kyverno ClusterPolicy (not native PSA) with additional mutation webhook that strips any securityContext.runAsUser < 1000. The restricted profile baseline is augmented with a custom Kyverno policy 'disallow-host-path-audit-tables' that validates container filesystem is read-only (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true). Database connection uses pg_bouncer with transaction-level pooling and a custom pg_bouncer auth function that maps the service account to a PostgreSQL role limited to INSERT on order_audit_* tables and UPDATE on inventory table only. The role has no CREATE TABLE, DROP, or ALTER privileges. Additionally, a Cilium L7 network policy inspects PostgreSQL wire protocol and blocks any statement containing DDL keywords (CREATE, DROP, ALTER, TRUNCATE) at the proxy layer.

config.db_role_grants: INSERT ON order_audit_* ; UPDATE(quantity) ON inventory
